bdg2.license: MIT (repository); see the paper for data terms
bdg2.citation: Miller, C. et al. (2020). The Building Data Genome Project 2, energy meter data from the ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III competition. Scientific Data, 7, 368.
preprocessing: subset of 10 buildings selected by documented quality criteria only (see subset_selection.csv)
gaps up to 3 steps interpolated within a building only
each building split chronologically into train/calibration/test

pleia.citation: Zamora-Martinez, F. et al. PLEIAData: consumption, HVAC, temperature, weather and motion sensor data for smart buildings. Zenodo, 2023.
preprocessing: physically implausible values outside [15.0, 40.0] degC removed
gaps up to 3 steps interpolated in time
pleia.target_description: PLEIAData indoor temperature, block B room 11 variable V2

pleia_energy.citation: Zamora-Martinez, F. et al. PLEIAData: consumption, HVAC, temperature, weather and motion sensor data for smart buildings. Zenodo, 2023.
preprocessing: target 'dif_cons' (per-interval consumption increment) from block B
0 negative increments masked as meter resets
gaps up to 3 steps interpolated in time
notes: cons_total (cumulative meter) deliberately not used as a target: it is near-monotonic and would make persistence trivially accurate.
pleia_energy.target_description: PLEIAData block B interval energy consumption (dif_cons)

rico.citation: Thiry, Z., Ruocco, M., Nocente, A., Oksavik, O. A. (2025). The RICO dataset: A multivariate HVAC indoors and outdoors time-series dataset. Data in Brief, 61, 111678.
preprocessing: runs = maximal contiguous Flag==1 blocks within (Acquisition Phase, Scheduler Step)
runs shorter than 120 samples or irregularly sampled were rejected
target = B.RTD3 (Pt100 air thermometer, 110 cm from the floor)
gaps up to 3 steps interpolated within a run only
seasonal-naive not applicable: a 4 h run contains no daily cycle
notes: 80 scheduler point(s) carried no Flag==1 sample and were excluded on the authors' own quality flag. Acquisition phase 2 is entirely unflagged, which matches the recording bug documented in the dataset README; excluding it is the authors' judgement, not ours.
rico.target_description: RICO indoor air temperature, B.RTD3 (Pt100 air thermometer, 110 cm from the floor)
rico.target_rationale: B.RTD3 is the documented Pt100 air thermometer at 110 cm, the standard seated-occupant measurement height for indoor air temperature, inside the actively controlled cell B. Chosen from the README's sensor documentation before any model was fitted; no forecast metric was consulted. B.RTD1 is excluded because the README places it in cell A, which was not under control, and B.RTD6 is a globe thermometer measuring operative rather than air temperature.
